producer_report.summary:
When the checks stage reuses a red GitHub CI run, Athena now reads the log of each failed `test (shard N)` job through the existing gh client. It records on the failed `test` check the failing test names from cargo's `failures:` list, in the same `<binary> <test>` form a local run uses, plus the last 200 lines of the log. The tail starts with a `failing units: <package> <selector>` line, and both are redacted before they are recorded. The verifier brief lists the names and the quoted tail and tells the verifier to run only those tests (`cargo test -p <crate> <name>`) unless it has a reason to run more. It also explains the name form and the `-p`/selector mapping, and warns that a name in parentheses means the list is incomplete.

Root cause: `resolve` turned a red run into a bare failed record, `runs_from_record` built the `test` check with empty `failed_tests` and `output_tail`, and the brief showed neither. The fix is at that source.

Completeness rule: when names are recorded and a failed shard's log was unread, listed no test, or the shard timed out or was cancelled, the list also holds `<job> (log not read)`, `<job> (no failing tests listed)` or `<job> (did not finish)`. A list over 50 names is cut with `(list cut at 50)`. No base has such a name, so a partly read set of shards is never judged pre-existing. A failed log read, a failed redaction, or a log with no `failures:` list leaves today's plain failed record. A green run makes no log call.

Reader audit (also in the CHANGELOG entry):
- `verify.rs` `is_pre_existing` and `failure_split` have new tests, and the doc comment is updated.
- `checks::log_entry` has a new test.
- `verify::check_result_view` and the brief have new tests.
- `status.rs` and `run/send_back.rs` only construct a `CheckRun`.
- `reading.rs` clips with `CARRIED_CHECK_OUTPUT_BYTES` and `introspect.rs` with `TAIL_CAP`.
- `athena-context` `outputs.rs` and `lib.rs` do not read either field.
- The `athena-cli` `status_durations` test only constructs a `CheckRun`, and `lifecycle` bounds the local-run tail.
I confirmed these by Grep.

open_issues: crates/athena-core/src/run/verification.rs is outside the listed deliverables. I changed it (wiring only) because it is the only place that turns CheckRuns into CheckResultViews, so the verifier cannot see the data without it. Athena should confirm it accepts this edit.
I did not run the xtask site build or rendered-page assertions, because no generated page content is touched.
I ran `cargo test -p athena-core -p athena-context` in full (about 4 minutes) but not the whole-workspace `cargo test --locked`; Athena's own checks will run that.
mistakes: The first clippy run flagged a needless borrow (`&secret`) in a new gh test; fixed and re-run clean.
learnings: Bash in this environment accepts only cargo, git, chmod, ls, mv and rm, with no pipes, so use `--quiet` for cargo output.

`Redactor::redact` returns athena_gate's own Result, so SnapExec converts it with `?` into anyhow. Redaction fails closed without gitleaks, so the gh tests use a stub Exec that replaces a marker string.

aggregate_verdict (gh/client.rs) calls a run red only when a `fmt`, `clippy` or `test (..)` job itself concluded exactly `failure`. A timed_out or cancelled shard alone gives `unusable`, so a did-not-finish marker only appears next to a real `failure` shard.
GitHub job logs have stamp-only blank lines with no trailing space, which `plain_log_line` handles; the 4-space indent of cargo's `failures:` list must survive the stamp strip.
xtask shard logs print `== shard k/n: <package> <selector>` before each unit, which is where the `failing units:` header comes from.
desires: A way to see the real format of a GitHub job log with a failing cargo shard (stamp spacing, blank lines) instead of reasoning from the xtask shard code and the existing stamp-handling tests.
